notes.title: Update on August 9, 2021
notes.content:
・Fixed object placement in some stages.
・Fixed an issue where the cursor and button assignments would sometimes shift in the title screen.
・Fixed an issue where the camera would show a wider area than expected in the ending.

notes.title: Update on August 3, 2021
notes.content:
・Fixed an issue where the behavior after switching gravity would differ depending on the PC environment.
・When playing in windowed mode, the aspect ratio is now maintained even when the window is resized.

notes.content: ・"Chinese" has been added to the language settings.

notes.title: Update on July 25, 2021
notes.content:
・Fixed a bug that allowed users to move during an event scene.
・Fixed the aspect ratio of the screen at 16:9. (You can use Alt + Enter to make the screen full screen, but the UI may be misaligned. Please be aware of this.）

tags.bug: ・Fixed a bug that allowed users to move during an event scene.
・Fixed the aspect ratio of the screen at 16:9.

notes.title: Update on July 24, 2021
notes.content:
・There was a bug in the behavior of climbing the wire mesh when using the WASD key, so it has been fixed.
・Fixed a bug in the restart behavior.
・The R key can now be used to restart a stage.
・Added the ability to use the spacebar to make decisions in menus.

notes.title: Update July 23, 2021.
notes.content:
・You can use the WASD keys to move.
・When all stages have been cleared, a scene will be added to the Ending.
